proof_boundary.proved: The actual transparent CurrentPermissions::held returns exactly .ok of requested permissions with at least one raw registration satisfying the established Grants predicate for the supplied original caller. Initial finite registration/FlatMap/filter/collection validity is constructed; empty requests and snapshots are included. Its concrete HeldModel and LawfulHeld are derived from that exact method and instantiate the existing successful-exchange issued_membership theorem: requested AND declared uses AND such a provider grant, with the supplied generic Context preserved. No whole computed-held-result assumption is supplied.
assumptions_and_limits: The existing generic uses/resource laws remain premises of the authority bridge. Preserving a supplied Context does not prove that an asynchronous endpoint constructed Context.caller from the same caller, nor establish catalog/principal freshness. The shared caller at the production call site is source correspondence only.

The supplied Principal (including native group projection and identity verification), raw declarations, and registration/catalog snapshot are inputs. SQL, snapshot construction/completeness/synchronization and storage authority are not verified.

Native Eq/Ord/Borrow/Clone correspondence, map/set traversal and representation, allocator/memory behavior, Arc lifetimes/aliasing/reference counts, and Rust standard-library refinement remain explicit boundaries. Ordinary finite Lean collection models are not a proof of native tree/memory implementation or call-count traces.

Only the synthetic local snapshot projection FnMut call_mut is externalized among the reviewed local forwarding bodies; it delegates to the modeled Arc value projection and preserves state. Native external primitives and opaque unused metadata types also remain documented model boundaries. Charon/Aeneas translation, Rust compiler and extraction configuration are trusted.

Actual decide_server admission/output, its sampled clock, current profile/principal/scope admission, signing, cryptography and transport remain outside this increment. The separately proved SDK239622d route seam is not adopted by the compiled SDK05273d1 pin.
Native tests call the actual CurrentPermissions method with synthetic fixtures; they do not authenticate real tokens or exercise deployment, networking, OpenShell execution or model inference.
